body:
*Plasmid FS for HAP1 & HepG2 samples*

- Cells are resuspended in 60 uL of Hia5 buffer (containing 0.05 % IGEPAL)  
- Incubate on ice for 10 mins.  
- Pellet nuclei at 350g, 5 min at 4 C.  
- Resuspend nuclei in 59 uL Hia5 buffer (with 0.8 mM SAM) & 0.5 uL of Hia5  
- Incubate at 25 C for 60 mins. Add SDS to a final concentration of 1% to stop the reaction.  
- Extract plasmid DNA by adding 134 uL Monarch Buffer B1. Then purify by mini-prep according to the kit instructions.  
- Linearize the plasmids based on *in vitro* CRISPR & clean-up the reactions

*Nucleosome recon for genomic DNA samples*

If we use 4 ug of DNA in a total of 25 uL volume:

Molarity of DNA \= 12.33 nM

Molarity of octamer required \= 740 nM ⇒ 2.01 ug in 25 uL solution

Prepare WT octamer stock → 0.402 ug/uL → 0.75 uL Octamer \+ 9.25 uL refolding buffer:glycerol \[1.075 M\]

5 uL of the octamer stock to be added to each of the DNA-salt mixes (20 uL) ⇒ Final salt concentration of the mix ⇒ 1.82 M
